tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: First appellate authority passed an order for reversal of Input tax credit on account of GSTR2A mismatch and questioning the eligibility of input tax credit for the years 2020-21 to 2021-22. The tax demand amount is Rs.24,28,910 and applicable interest/penalty.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Additional Commissioner of Central Excise & customs (Appeals-II)
tax_litigation.status: Appeal is yet to be filed.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The company’s writ petition to declare the proviso to Section 34A(5) of the Tamil Nadu Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowment Act 1959 as illegal and ultra vires and unenforceable insofar as the company is concerned has been dismissed by the Hon’ble Madras High Court.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments Department
tax_litigation.status: There is no impact on the business and operations of the company. In fact, the company has given the information on this under contingent liability in the Annual Reports. The company is exploring options
